candidates.name: Horizon Pipeline North Extension Project
candidates.sponsor: Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America LLC and Horizon Pipeline Company LLC
candidates.to: Town of Paris, Kenosha County, Wisconsin (Red Oak Ridge Energy Center area)

evidence.note: FERC scoping notice for the North Extension Project, Docket CP26-564, Illinois counties and Kenosha County
Joint FERC application filed August 12, 2026, $438.5 million, new firm transportation capacity for Wisconsin Electric Power Company
Kenosha County page: about 11.5 miles into Kenosha County, ending in the Town of Paris, added capacity for We Energies; same page covers the Red Oak Ridge plant approval
Microsoft has signed up to buy electricity from the planned Red Oak Ridge Energy Center, which We Energies is asking to buy from Invenergy
PSC approval of the Kenosha County plant framed around data center demand including Microsoft's Mount Pleasant campus

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row covers this extension. P0201 Horizon Gas Pipeline runs Joliet to McHenry County. Length about 11.5 miles (18.5 km). The filings name We Energies as shipper and the Town of Paris as the terminus, where the Red Oak Ridge plant sits; no source quoted here says in so many words that the line is for that plant, so the tie to the plant is by location and shipper.

seed_ledger.name: Entergy Corp: gas supply to its plants in development (group 3 of 3)
seed_ledger.reason: Vicksburg Advanced: EXISTING_ROW, P8126 Columbia Gulf Vicksburg Lateral already serves the Baxter Wilson and Warren plant sites in Warren County where the new 754 MW plant is built; Entergy's annual report says the plant qualifies for pre-certification under the Mississippi law for data center customers, and the Amazon campuses are in the same county, so the tie is indirect and Entergy says the plant is needed without Amazon; tag lead only. Lake Catherine (Ironwood replacement for Unit 4): ONSITE_NO_PIPE, 446 MW simple-cycle unit on 20 acres of existing site, no new pipe and no data center tie named. Entergy Arkansas IRP stations 3, 4 and 6: NO_DC_TIE, unsited placeholders in the 2024 resource plan with no pipeline. Searches run: 4. Sources checked: Entergy Mississippi news and blog pages (plant for load growth, no pipeline), Entergy 2025 annual report (pre-certification for data center law), Mississippi Free Press (Entergy says need exists without Amazon), Entergy Arkansas Ironwood groundbreaking release (general load growth), Arkansas Business (no pipeline).

evidence.note: Vicksburg plant qualifies for pre-certification under Mississippi data center customer legislation
Entergy says generation needed regardless of Amazon
Ironwood replaces Lake Catherine Unit 4 on existing site, load growth, no pipeline named

seed_ledger.name: Blackstone Inc: gas supply to its plants in development (group 1 of 2)
seed_ledger.reason: Red Oak Ridge: NEW_ROW, Horizon Pipeline North Extension, about 11.5 miles, Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America and Horizon Pipeline sponsors, FERC CP26-564 filed August 2026, proposed, firm capacity for We Energies ending in the Town of Paris; plant tied to data centers by Microsoft's signed purchase of its power; a separate 4-mile local extension linking the Kinder Morgan line to the We Energies Lakeshore Lateral (P8299) is mentioned by the county but no sponsor filing found. Lincoln Land: NO_DC_TIE, 2022 air permit and gas from Panhandle Eastern and Rockies Express nearby, no data center named. Invenergy Calumet County (Union Depot 750 MW and Forest Junction 1.2 GW): NO_DC_TIE, Invenergy and We Energies declined to name data centers, no pipeline named. Sycamore Riverside: NO_DC_TIE for this plant; I&M filing (Cause 46389) cites general load growth and the plant has a 5.5-mile 24-inch ONEOK lateral precedent agreement per its Indiana filing (via a tracker, not a primary source), a below-threshold monitor line if a tie surfaces. West Royal: NO_DC_TIE, only an ERCOT queue entry for 888 MW by Invenergy, no pipeline or data center source. Searches run: 8. Sources checked: Kenosha County utility page (pipeline and plant), FERC scoping notice, Environment+Energy Leader, Racine County Eye (Microsoft contract), Heartland Post and Hoodline (approval, data center demand), WPR (Calumet, no data center confirmed), AEP release (Sycamore need), Power Engineering (Lincoln Land permit), ERCOT queue pages (West Royal).
